simple.summary: עֵין חָצוֹר (ʻÊyn Châtsôwr) means En-Chatsor , a place in Palestine First listed occurrence: Josh 19 37.

definitions.full: H5877. En Chatsor חָצוֺר עֵין proper name, of a location in Naphtali Josh 19:37 , πηγὴ Ασορ .
